en: Black-and-white postcard-style photograph of a large Baroque castle complex with two prominent round corner towers topped by domed roofs and lanterns, a central multi-storey palace wing, and an adjacent chapel with a tall spire. In the foreground is a formal garden with neatly trimmed conical trees and a lawn, separated from the building by a balustraded terrace on a stone base.
